help.render:
Render a composition to MP4, WebM, MOV, GIF, or a PNG sequence (hyperframes render v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes render [OPTIONS] [DIR]

ARGUMENTS

  DIR    Project directory

OPTIONS

                    -c, --composition=<composition>    Render a specific composition file instead of index.html (e.g. compositions/intro.html). Sub-compositions using <template> wrappers must be referenced from index.html via data-composition-src. Pass `.` (or omit the flag) to render the project's index.html.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                              -o, --output=<output>    Output path (default: renders/<name>.mp4)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                    -f, --fps=<fps>    Frame rate. Accepts integer (24, 25, 30, 50, 60, 120, 240) or ffmpeg-style rational (30000/1001 for NTSC 29.97, 24000/1001 for 23.976, 60000/1001 for 59.94). Range 1-240. Defaults to the composition's root data-fps, else 30.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                            -q, --quality=<quality>    Quality: draft, standard, high (Default: standard)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                    --skill=<skill>    Authoring workflow skill that initiated this render (e.g. product-launch-video). Recorded on anonymous render telemetry for per-skill usage breakdowns; ignored unless it is a slug.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                  --format=<format>    Output format: mp4, webm, mov, gif, png-sequence (MOV/WebM render with transparency; png-sequence writes RGBA frames to a directory for AE/Nuke/Fusion ingest; gif is best at 15fps for PRs/docs) (Default: mp4)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                              --gif-loop=<gif_loop>    GIF loop count, 0 = infinite. Range: 0-65535. Only used with --format gif.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
          --video-frame-format=<video_frame_format>    Source video frame extraction format: auto, jpg, png (default: auto). Use png for UI recordings, screen captures, and color-sensitive source videos; alpha-capable sources always extract as PNG. (Default: auto)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                            -w, --workers=<workers>    Parallel render workers (number or 'auto'). Default: auto. Each worker launches a separate Chrome process (~256 MB RAM).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                           --docker    Use Docker for deterministic render (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                              --hdr    Force HDR output even if no HDR sources are detected (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                              --sdr    Force SDR output even if HDR sources are detected (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                        --crf=<crf>    Override encoder CRF. Mutually exclusive with --video-bitrate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                    --video-bitrate=<video_bitrate>    Target video bitrate such as 10M. Mutually exclusive with --crf.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                      --vp9-cpu-used=<vp9_cpu_used>    libvpx-vp9 -cpu-used value for WebM encodes (-8 to 8). Higher is faster with a larger quality/size tradeoff. Env: PRODUCER_VP9_CPU_USED.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                              --gpu    Use GPU encoding (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                      --browser-gpu    Force host GPU acceleration for Chrome/WebGL capture. Default: auto (probe on first launch; fall back to software if no GPU). Use --no-browser-gpu to force software (SwiftShader).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                            --quiet    Suppress verbose output (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                            --debug    Write full render diagnostics and keep intermediate artifacts under the producer .debug directory. (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                      --best-effort    Allow output with structured capture-readiness warnings (default). Use --no-best-effort to fail on missing or unready media. (Default: true)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                   --no-best-effort                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                           --strict    Fail render on lint errors (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                       --strict-all    Fail render on lint errors AND warnings (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  --max-concurrent-renders=<max_concurrent_renders>    Max concurrent renders when using the producer server (1-10). Default: 2.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                            --variables=<variables>    JSON object of variable values, merged over the composition's data-composition-variables defaults. Example: --variables '{"title":"Hello"}'. Read inside the composition via window.__hyperframes.getVariables().                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                  --variables-file=<variables_file>    Path to a JSON file with variable values (alternative to --variables). The file must contain a single JSON object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                 --strict-variables    Fail render if any --variables key is undeclared or has a wrong type vs the composition's data-composition-variables. Without this flag, mismatches are warnings. (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                    --batch=<batch>    Path to a JSON array of variable rows (or {"rows":[...]}). Renders one output per row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
            --batch-concurrency=<batch_concurrency>    Maximum number of batch rows to render at once. Default: 1, because each render already parallelizes across workers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
                                  --batch-fail-fast    Stop launching new batch rows after the first row failure. (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                             --json    With --batch, emit exactly one final JSON result document. (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                          --resolution=<resolution>    Output resolution preset: landscape (1920x1080), portrait (1080x1920), landscape-4k (3840x2160), portrait-4k (2160x3840), square (1080x1080), square-4k (2160x2160). Aliases: 1080p, 4k, uhd, 1080p-square, square-1080p, 4k-square. The composition is unchanged — Chrome renders at higher DPR (deviceScaleFactor) so the captured screenshot lands at the requested dimensions. Aspect ratio must match the composition; the scale must be an integer multiple. Not yet supported with --hdr.                                                
                            --page-side-compositing    Run shader transitions on a page-side WebGL canvas inside Chrome instead of the Node-side layered blend. ~6× faster for SDR shader-transition renders. HDR/alpha/video content auto-disables. Use --no-page-side-compositing to force the layered path. (Default: true)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                         --no-page-side-compositing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                --browser-timeout=<browser_timeout>    Puppeteer page-navigation timeout in SECONDS for the entry HTML. Increase when heavy compositions (many videos / fonts / asset requests) cannot reach domcontentloaded within the 60s default (see issue #1199). Accepts 0.001-86400 (24h cap). Note: this controls page.goto only — very heavy compositions may also need PRODUCER_PUPPETEER_PROTOCOL_TIMEOUT_MS / PRODUCER_PLAYER_READY_TIMEOUT_MS bumped (the post-goto window.__hf readiness poll has its own 45s budget). Env fallback: PRODUCER_PAGE_NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT_MS (MILLISECONDS).
              --protocol-timeout=<protocol_timeout>    CDP protocol timeout in ms. Increase on slow/low-memory machines where Chrome operations time out. Default: 300000 (5 min). Env: PRODUCER_PUPPETEER_PROTOCOL_TIMEOUT_MS.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
      --player-ready-timeout=<player_ready_timeout>    Timeout in ms for the composition player to become ready. Increase for complex compositions on slow hardware. Default: 45000 (45 s). Env: PRODUCER_PLAYER_READY_TIMEOUT_MS.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                  --low-memory-mode    Force the low-memory safe render profile on (--low-memory-mode) or off (--no-low-memory-mode). Safe mode pins to 1 worker, uses screenshot capture, and skips auto-worker calibration to avoid memory thrash on constrained machines. Default: auto-detected from total RAM (<= 8 GB). Env: PRODUCER_LOW_MEMORY_MODE.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                        --experimental-fast-capture    Capture frames via Chrome's drawElementImage API instead of Page.captureScreenshot — reads DOM paint records directly, ~2x faster. Default: on where it can engage (macOS + hardware-GPU browser); incompatible compositions and self-verification failures fall back to screenshot capture automatically. Pass =false to disable. Env: PRODUCER_EXPERIMENTAL_FAST_CAPTURE.                                                                                                                                                                     
              --frames-cache-dir=<frames_cache_dir>    Directory for the content-addressed extracted-frame cache. Use to relocate the cache off the system drive when the OS temp directory lives on a small partition (e.g. Windows C: exhaustion during long renders). Pass "off" / "none" / "false" / "0" to disable caching entirely (frames extract into the render's workDir and are cleaned up when the render ends). Default: <tmpdir>/hyperframes-extract-cache-<uid>. Env: HYPERFRAMES_EXTRACT_CACHE_DIR.

Check system dependencies and environment (hyperframes doctor v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes doctor [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

help.lint:
Validate a composition for common mistakes (hyperframes lint v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes lint [OPTIONS] [DIR]

ARGUMENTS

  DIR    Project directory

OPTIONS

     --json    Output findings as JSON (Default: false)                     
  --verbose    Show info-level findings (hidden by default) (Default: false)
help.snapshot:
Capture key frames from a composition as PNG screenshots for visual verification (hyperframes snapshot v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes snapshot [OPTIONS] [DIR]

ARGUMENTS

  DIR    Project directory

OPTIONS

      -o, --output=<output>    Directory to write snapshots into (default: <project>/snapshots)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
          --frames=<frames>    Number of evenly-spaced frames to capture (default: 5) (Default: 5)                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                  --at=<at>    Comma-separated timestamps in seconds (e.g., --at 3.0,10.5,18.0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
        --timeout=<timeout>    Ms to wait for runtime to initialize (default: 5000) (Default: 5000)                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
            --angle=<angle>    Orthogonal 3D camera for depth/occlusion checks: a preset (front|iso|top|side) or 'yaw,pitch' degrees. Tilts the whole stage before screenshotting (real pixels, not bbox markers).                                                                                                        
                      --end    Always include a readable end-of-timeline frame (default: true). Pass --no-end to capture only your exact --at times. (Default: true)                                                                                                                                                      
                   --no-end                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
              --zoom=<zoom>    Zoom into a CSS selector or an exact pixel region 'x,y,w,h'. Crops a high-density screenshot instead of the full frame — a raised deviceScaleFactor, never CSS zoom or viewport resizing, so layout stays identical. A selector matching nothing is an error, not a silent full-frame shot.
  --zoom-scale=<zoom_scale>    Device-scale-factor density for --zoom crops (default: 3) (Default: 3)                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
        --against=<against>    Reference video (e.g. footage being rebuilt): also save its frame at each captured time and a render|reference pair sheet                                                                                                                                                                  
      --describe=<describe>    Gemini vision frame analysis. Runs by default when GEMINI_API_KEY is set. Pass a custom question (e.g. --describe 'Is the logo visible in every beat?') to override the default prompt, or --describe false to opt out.                                                                    
                    --proxy    Auto-transcode browser-hostile video codecs for snapshots (default: on; overrides hyperframes.json media.autoProxy)                                                                                                                                                                        
              --browser-gpu    Use hardware browser GPU capture; pass --no-browser-gpu for deterministic SwiftShader (default: auto-detect, PRODUCER_BROWSER_GPU_MODE overrides)
help.check:
Run lint, runtime, layout, motion, and WCAG contrast verification in one browser session (hyperframes check v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes check [OPTIONS] [DIR]

ARGUMENTS

  DIR    Project directory

OPTIONS

                                             --json    Output agent-readable JSON (Default: false)                                                                                                                                   
                                --samples=<samples>    Number of midpoint samples across the duration (default: 9) (Default: 9)                                                                                                      
                                          --at=<at>    Comma-separated timestamps in seconds (e.g., --at 1.5,4,7.25)                                                                                                                 
                                   --at-transitions    Also sample at every tween start/end boundary (plus segment midpoints) to catch transient overlaps at transition seams (Default: false)                                       
  --max-transition-samples=<max_transition_samples>    Optional cap on transition-derived samples; when it truncates, the omitted count is reported (default: unlimited)                                                             
                          --max-issues=<max_issues>    Maximum issues to print or return after static collapse (default: 80) (Default: 80)                                                                                           
                                  --collapse-static    Collapse repeated static issues across samples (default: true) (Default: true)                                                                                                
                               --no-collapse-static                                                                                                                                                                                  
                            --tolerance=<tolerance>    Allowed pixel overflow before reporting an issue (default: 2) (Default: 2)                                                                                                    
                                --timeout=<timeout>    Initial render-ready timeout in ms; also sets the navigation minimum (10s floor, default: 3000) (Default: 3000)                                                               
                                         --contrast    Run the WCAG AA contrast pass (enabled by default) (Default: true)                                                                                                            
                                      --no-contrast                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                           --strict    Exit non-zero on warnings too (Default: false)                                                                                                                                
                                            --proxy    Auto-transcode browser-hostile video codecs (default: hyperframes.json media.autoProxy, which defaults on)                                                                    
                                      --browser-gpu    Use hardware browser GPU capture; pass --no-browser-gpu for deterministic SwiftShader (default: auto-detect, PRODUCER_BROWSER_GPU_MODE overrides)                             
                                        --snapshots    Save the five contrast-pass PNGs under snapshots/ (Default: false)                                                                                                            
                      --caption-zone=<caption_zone>    Caption band "x0=0;y0=.82;x1=1;y1=1[;severity=warning|error][;seek=.5,1]" (fractions 0-1; defaults: warning, seek=1)                                                          
                        --frame-check=<frame_check>    Bare --frame-check uses defaults (tol=2px, severity=warning, seek=.5; breach floor=max(120px, 6% of shorter canvas edge)); or pass "severity=error;seek=.25,.75;tol=4" to tune
                                  --layout=<layout>    Layout knobs: "proseCoverageFloor=0.05" (0–1; default 0.15).
help.compare:
Render independent composition variants into one labeled comparison sheet (hyperframes compare v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes compare [OPTIONS] [PATH]

ARGUMENTS

  PATH    Composition project directory or .html file (pass 2+ paths)

OPTIONS

            --at=<at>    Timeline time in seconds to seek before screenshotting each variant
    --labels=<labels>    Comma-separated labels matching the variant path count             
          --out=<out>    Output comparison sheet path (default: ./compare.png)              
        --cols=<cols>    Grid columns (default: sqrt heuristic, capped at 4)                
  --timeout=<timeout>    Render-ready timeout in ms per variant (default: 5000)             
               --json    Output result as JSON (Default: false)
help.grade-compare:
Render candidate color grades onto a reference frame as one comparison PNG (hyperframes grade-compare v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes grade-compare [OPTIONS] --for=<for>

OPTIONS

          --for=<for>    Reference image path, or a video path to sample at t=0 (Required)                                 
    --grades=<grades>    JSON array of { label, grading } candidate grades                                                 
        --luts=<luts>    Comma-separated .cube LUT paths to compare                                                        
  --project=<project>    Base directory for relative --for, --grades, and LUT paths (default: cwd)                         
          --out=<out>    Output PNG path (default: <project>/grade-compare.png)                                            
               --json    Output result as JSON (Default: false)                                                            
  --timeout=<timeout>    Render-ready timeout in ms before capture (default: 5000)                                         
           --baseline    Prepend the ungraded frame as an 'original' reference cell (--no-baseline to omit) (Default: true)
        --no-baseline
help.preview:
Start the studio for previewing compositions (hyperframes preview v0.8.31)

USAGE hyperframes preview [OPTIONS] [DIR]

ARGUMENTS

  DIR    Project directory

OPTIONS

                                    --port=<port>    Port to run the preview server on (Default: 3002)                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                      --force-new    Start a new server even if one is already running for this project (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                        
                                     --background    Start a preview that remains running after the command exits (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                              
                                     --foreground    Keep preview attached even when the shell is non-interactive (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                              
                                         --status    Show the background preview for this project and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                     
                                           --stop    Stop the background preview for this project and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                     
                                           --list    List all active preview servers and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                       --kill-all    Kill all active preview servers and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                           --open    Open browser automatically (Default: true)                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                        --no-open                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                      --selection    Print the current element selected in a running Studio preview and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                   
                                           --json    Output selection, context, or managed lifecycle state as JSON (Default: false)                                                                                                                                                             
                                        --context    Print the current agent-readable context from a running Studio preview and exit (Default: false)                                                                                                                                           
                --context-fields=<context_fields>    Comma-separated context fields to include: server,selection,lint,capabilities (only with --context)                                                                                                                                        
                --context-detail=<context_detail>    Context payload detail: compact or full (only with --context) (Default: compact)                                                                                                                                                           
                    --browser-path=<browser_path>    Path to the browser executable to open                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                  --user-data-dir=<user_data_dir>    Chromium-compatible user data directory (requires --browser-path)                                                                                                                                                                          
  --remote-debugging-port=<remote_debugging_port>    Chromium remote debugging port (requires --browser-path and --user-data-dir)                                                                                                                                                               
                                 --browser-no-gpu    Launch the opened browser with --disable-gpu (requires --browser-path). For hosts where hardware acceleration crashes the graphics driver (e.g. NVIDIA Xid resets); with the system default browser use --no-open instead. (Default: false)
                                    --browser-gpu    Use hardware GPU for Studio thumbnails and frame capture; pass --no-browser-gpu for deterministic SwiftShader (default: auto-detect)                                                                                                       
                                          --proxy    Auto-transcode browser-hostile video codecs (HEVC, ProRes, AV1) to a cached authoring proxy for preview (default: on; overrides hyperframes.json's media.autoProxy)                                                                        
                                       --no-proxy    Disable auto-proxying of browser-hostile video codecs
help.upgrade:

               --json    Output as JSON (Default: false)                                                                    
  --project=<project>    Bump this project's package.json hyperframes@<version> script pins to latest (default: current dir)
